mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_mgt( user_sys_id, recipe_title, recipe_info, recipe_ingredients, recipe_steps, view_count, recipe_thumbnail_image, recipe_Instagram_link, recipe_video_link, recipe_video_file, rec_create_id, rec_create_date, rec_update_id, rec_update_date, logical_del_flag ) VALUES ( #{userSysId}, #{recipeTitle}, #{recipeInfo}, #{recipeIngredients}, #{recipeSteps}, 0, #{recipeThumbnailImage}, #{recipeInstagramLink}, #{recipeVideoLink}, #{recipeVideoFile}, #{userSysId}, now(), #{userSysId}, now(), '0' )
mapper.select: SELECT recipe_id::text AS id, user_sys_id AS userSysId, recipe_title AS recipeTitle, recipe_info AS recipeInfo, recipe_ingredients AS recipeIngredients, recipe_steps AS recipeSteps, view_count AS viewCount, recipe_thumbnail_image AS recipeThumbnailImage, recipe_instagram_link AS recipeInstagramLink, recipe_video_link AS recipeVideoLink, recipe_video_file AS recipeVideoFile, rec_create_date AS recCreateDatetime FROM recipe_mgt WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' ORDER BY rec_create_date DESC

SELECT recipe_id::text AS id, user_sys_id AS userSysId, recipe_title AS recipeTitle, recipe_info AS recipeInfo, recipe_ingredients AS recipeIngredients, recipe_steps AS recipeSteps, view_count AS viewCount, recipe_thumbnail_image AS recipeThumbnailImage, recipe_instagram_link AS recipeInstagramLink, recipe_video_link AS recipeVideoLink, recipe_video_file AS recipeVideoFile, rec_create_date AS recCreateDatetime FROM recipe_mgt WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' AND recipe_id = CAST(#{id} AS BIGINT)

SELECT recipe_id::text AS id, user_sys_id AS userSysId, recipe_title AS recipeTitle, recipe_info AS recipeInfo, recipe_ingredients AS recipeIngredients, recipe_steps AS recipeSteps, view_count AS viewCount, recipe_thumbnail_image AS recipeThumbnailImage, recipe_instagram_link AS recipeInstagramLink, recipe_video_link AS recipeVideoLink, recipe_video_file AS recipeVideoFile, rec_create_date AS recCreateDatetime FROM recipe_mgt WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' AND user_sys_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rec_create_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE recipe_mgt SET recipe_title = #{recipeTitle}, recipe_info = #{recipeInfo}, recipe_ingredients = #{recipeIngredients}, recipe_steps = #{recipeSteps}, recipe_thumbnail_image = #{recipeThumbnailImage}, recipe_instagram_link = #{recipeInstagramLink}, recipe_video_link = #{recipeVideoLink}, recipe_video_file = #{recipeVideoFile}, rec_update_id = #{userSysId}, rec_update_date = now() WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' AND recipe_id = CAST(#{id} AS BIGINT) AND user_sys_id = #{userSysId}
UPDATE recipe_mgt SET logical_del_flag = '1', rec_update_id = #{userId}, rec_update_date = now() WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' AND recipe_id = CAST(#{id} AS BIGINT) AND user_sys_id = #{userId}
UPDATE recipe_mgt SET view_count = COALESCE(view_count, 0) + 1, rec_update_date = now() WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' AND recipe_id = CAST(#{id} AS BIGINT)
mapper.select: SELECT rcm.comment_id::text AS commentId, rcm.recipe_id::text AS recipeId, rcm.user_sys_id AS userSysId, COALESCE(mm.user_login_id, rcm.user_sys_id) AS writerId, rcm.comment_text AS commentText, rcm.rec_create_date AS recCreateDatetime FROM recipe_comment_mgt rcm LEFT JOIN member_mgt mm ON mm.user_sys_id = rcm.user_sys_id WHERE rcm.logical_del_flag = '0' AND rcm.recipe_id = CAST(#{recipeId} AS BIGINT) ORDER BY rcm.rec_create_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_comment_mgt( recipe_id, user_sys_id, comment_text, rec_create_id, rec_create_date, rec_update_id, rec_update_date, logical_del_flag ) VALUES ( CAST(#{recipeId} AS BIGINT), #{userSysId}, #{commentText}, #{userSysId}, now(), #{userSysId}, now(), '0' )
mapper.select: SELECT rcm.comment_id::text AS commentId, rm.recipe_id::text AS recipeId, rm.recipe_title AS recipeTitle, COALESCE(mm.user_login_id, rcm.user_sys_id) AS writerId, rcm.comment_text AS commentText, rcm.rec_create_date AS recCreateDatetime FROM recipe_comment_mgt rcm INNER JOIN recipe_mgt rm ON rm.recipe_id = rcm.recipe_id LEFT JOIN member_mgt mm ON mm.user_sys_id = rcm.user_sys_id WHERE rcm.logical_del_flag = '0' AND rm.logical_del_flag = '0' AND rm.user_sys_id = #{userSysId} AND rcm.user_sys_id != #{userSysId} ORDER BY rcm.rec_create_date DESC LIMIT 20
